dif.summary: Recover the authoritative state of one ambiguous provider-neutral payment attempt before authorizing any new financial mutation.

allowed_paths: recover authoritative transaction state before any new mutation
blocked_paths: issue a new payment mutation before resolving the prior commit state
constraints: Preserve the original logical operation identity.
Do not create a second payment effect while commit state is unresolved.
Use only provider-neutral deterministic evidence in this example.

drp.decision_summary: Recover the authoritative transaction state for the existing logical operation before any new financial mutation; if an existing committed effect is confirmed, accept it and do not pay again.

tip.action_summary: Read the authoritative state of the existing logical operation; do not create a new payment effect.
